what: CMS Energy is a Michigan utility holding company. Its main subsidiary Consumers Energy delivers electricity and natural gas across most of the state, and it owns a small independent power business.
customers: About 1.9 million electricity and 1.8 million gas customers across Michigan.
moat: A regulated monopoly across most of Michigan, with rates set by the state commission.
risks: Debt of about $19 billion against almost no cash
Michigan regulators set allowed returns and have been demanding on reliability
Coal plant retirements require replacement generation investment
Return on invested capital of about 5%
opportunities: Revenue grew about 14% last year with a 20% operating margin
Data centre interest in Michigan raises projected load growth
Grid reliability investment adds to the base it earns a regulated return on
watch: Rate case outcomes and data centre load commitments.
